name: com.hippocall.HippoJitsiMeetActivity
description: When Hippo Calling (Jungle Works) starts or rejoins a voice or video call, this Activity opens the Jitsi conference screen and handles connected, ended, and connection-timeout states. It also supports picture-in-picture while a call continues.
disableEffect: Hippo voice and video calls cannot open or rejoin their in-app conference screen.
